question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Analytical
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Examining**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Analytical"** means relating to or using analysis or logical reasoning. (विश्लेषणात्मक)

 
 
• **Example: **She has an analytical mind, always breaking down problems into smaller parts to understand them better.
 
 
 
• **"Examining"** means inspecting or scrutinizing something carefully. (जाँच करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The detective was examining the evidence to find any clues about the crime.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Examining**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Pretending** (दिखावा करना): Behaving as if something is true when it is not.

 
 
• **Example:** He was only pretending to be asleep when his mother walked in.
 
 
 
• **Cursory** (सरसरी): Hasty and therefore not thorough or detailed.
 
 
• **Example: **He gave a cursory glance at the report and missed the crucial details.
 
 
 
• **Chaotic** (अराजक): In a state of complete confusion and disorder.
 
 
• **Example:** The traffic was chaotic during the festival season.
